authority.scope: Close the existing First Dream loop before adding economy, song-family, HUD, dungeon, enemy, or quest breadth.
authority.evidence_policy: Source presence, offline proof, live proof, and packaged proof are distinct. Historical passes apply only to their captured baselines and are not current shipping certification.

active_p0_gates.contract: Exactly one rhythm execution path reaches the stock JRPG damage calculation; load-bearing MelodiaCore presentation and reactivity callers may remain.
UMelodiaUIBridgeSubsystem is the sole Melodia writer for battle-time presentation and the instantiated runtime widget identity is proven.
Real-key timing grade changes a stock JRPG result without blocking progression, and Quill resumes exactly once.
Equip through the wardrobe authority, save canonically, restart the process, load, and restore the correct outfit and materials.
One equipped wardrobe item provides one observable inventory/capability hook; Glide is the first-slice capability.
One existing Piano phrase commits one idempotent typed world result and visibly opens one player-facing route.
The current frozen baseline passes the graph, live-path, Blueprint sweep, UI, and material-baseline checks without waivers.
Victory, Defeat, Fled, and unavailable each produce the typed result and resume or abort Quill exactly once on the current integration map.

bounded_historical_evidence.scope: Real keyboard input on the captured owner session.
Canonical stock-JRPG save across the captured process restart.
Captured authored replay remained exactly once.
Captured Development package launched outside the editor.

current_source_truth.battle_hud: Source is converged: UMelodiaJRPGBattleOverlaySubsystem is a retired compatibility observer and creates no widgets. Runtime hud_single_writer proof remains open.
current_source_truth.music_world_key: Piano and UMelodiaPCGNarrativeChallengeBridgeComponent are source-built. Live host attachment, level wiring, visible route payoff, and replay proof remain open.
current_source_truth.rhythm_owner: The gate measures one execution path into stock JRPG damage, not zero MelodiaCore callers. Load-bearing presentation and reactivity callers are permitted.
